results.verdict: WEAK / NON-DECISIVE POSITIVE: feature-level fusion S+M (AUROC 0.920±0.014) is the BEST model (> structure S 0.906, > modules M 0.835, > best-single 0.831) and beats structure by delta +0.013 with lower variance — but the margin does NOT clear the pre-registered >1sd bar, so per the fixed decision rule this is H1-FAIL: hypothesis-generating, NOT a validated improvement. Modules add a small, consistent-but-not-decisive transfer signal on top of structure; do not ship fusion as a validated win. (Still more positive than B32's scalar late-fusion, which lost to best-single.)
